products.title: Pokemon - 30th Celebration - Booster Pack
products.body_html:
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon Trading Card Game history with this special anniversary booster pack. Each pack contains 5 foil cards, 1 foil Basic Energy card, and a Pokémon TCG Live code card.

Discover brand-new Futuristic Rare cards including Mewtwo ex and Mew ex, alongside beautifully illustrated cards featuring iconic Pokémon moments. The set showcases 30 unique holographic Pikachu cards created by different illustrators—a tribute to the artists who've shaped the TCG over three decades.

Relive nostalgia with 30 reprinted classic cards from Pokémon TCG history, including fan favorites like Charizard, Greninja ex, and Pikachu & Zekrom-GX. Perfect for collectors and players alike, this limited-edition release combines new designs with timeless classics.

Note: Reprinted classic cards are not legal in Standard format but remain playable in formats where original versions are permitted.
